_comment: Exp 43 — MACROPHAGE admissibility (verdict-wiring confirmation under live load). GENERALISATION TEST of the convergence fix proven on Exp 42: does the code-LOCATION novelty key + the TWO-SIDED convergence gate work on a SECOND, different module, or was composer.py special? Target bench/macrophage_cell.py (547 lines, ~22K chars, self-contained stdlib-only, 15 AST symbols — confirmed a clean location-keyed review target; the operational-plan 'immune_agents.py macrophage section' pointer was WRONG and is corrected). SAME instrument as the Exp 42 landmark: single fixed runner, CONFIRM-only falsifier gate, capability-aware take-up-slack routing (Codex->CC2), code-location novelty key. CONVERGENCE = the TWO-SIDED GATE (founder ruling 2026-06-10, gamma is LOAD-BEARING, NOT demoted): converged iff BOTH (1) gamma_critical >= gamma_alt_threshold (0.30) — the critical decay curve has flattened — AND (2) gamma_alt_consecutive_zero_crit (3) consecutive rounds with zero NEW genuine critical on the SETTLED/verifier-filtered, location-keyed series — the strict threshold-free endpoint; both are sides of the same diminishing-returns measure and naturally agree (verified: exp41c gamma_critical=1.0, exp42=0.69, both clear 0.30; the count is the binding side). Guarded by (a) the A4 verifier fail-safe (an UNCONFIRMED sev>=0.7 candidate blocks + is logged for HIL, never silently counted as zero), (b) not-contested, (c) not-churning, (d) the small irreducible-queue alarm. PREDICTION: if the fix generalises, macrophage_cell.py converges within the round budget with low/zero residual HIL. If it does NOT converge, the cause is almost certainly MECHANICAL (dedup/routing/wiring), NOT the model or the maths — diagnose under cy, do not demote gamma. Report BOTH directions honestly: true-convergence-preserved AND false-convergence-prevented. severity_calibration is deliberately OFF (it is inert without a latent-tagger and would confound a clean generalisation test). CX2 is wired separately and is NOT a 6th panel model.
_stall_gamma_note: Stall-path gamma thresholds set above the gamma ceiling (1.0) so the stall detector can never fire via gamma — convergence rests on the two-sided gamma-alt gate (gamma_critical AND zero-new-critical count), not the state-gate or stall-path gamma. Config-level guard, not a behaviour change.
_test_cmd_note: Macrophage regression guard (runs in a sandbox against any proposed fix, 120s cap). bench/tests/test_immune_agents.py covers the macrophage's advisory invariant (pipeline_modified=False) and observe() behaviour. apply_fixes_back_enabled=false (static review) so this guard is informational this run; it is the macrophage-relevant suite rather than the broader dynamic-management baseline used for Exp 42.

_convergence_criteria.description: TWO-SIDED GATE (founder ruling 2026-06-10; hardened_gate_enabled=false). gamma is ACTIVE and LOAD-BEARING (NOT reported-only). Converged iff ALL of: (1) gamma_critical >= gamma_alt_threshold (0.30) — the critical decay curve, on the location-keyed critical series, has flattened; AND (2) gamma_alt_consecutive_zero_crit (3) consecutive rounds with zero NEW genuine critical on the settled/verifier-filtered, location-keyed series; AND (3) no unverified critical candidate pending (A4 fail-safe — UNCONFIRMED sev>=0.7 blocks + logged for HIL); AND (4) not contested; AND (5) not churning; AND (6) irreducible queue within bound. The two gamma_critical and count conditions are sides of the same diminishing-returns measure and naturally agree. All-severity novelty is NOT required to be low.
_convergence_criteria.pass_condition: gamma_critical >= 0.30 (decay curve flattened) AND 3 consecutive zero-NEW-genuine-critical rounds (settled, location-keyed) AND no unverified (UNCONFIRMED sev>=0.7) critical pending AND not contested AND not churning AND irreducible queue within bound.
_convergence_criteria.fail_condition: Any model fails to produce parseable output in 2+ consecutive rounds; OR non-convergence (then assume MECHANICAL, diagnose under cy — do not demote gamma).

_pre_registration: Frozen 2026-06-10 before the run. Exp 43 generalisation test of the Exp 42 convergence landmark on a NEW target (bench/macrophage_cell.py). Thresholds identical to the Exp 42 landmark: gamma_alt_threshold=0.30 (the ACTIVE gamma side of the two-sided gate), gamma_alt_consecutive_zero_crit=3, consecutive_rounds_required=3, earliest_stop_round=3, hardened_gate_enabled=false, location_keyed_convergence=true, take_up_slack_enabled=true, falsifier_gate_enabled=true. gamma is LOAD-BEARING (the two-sided gate requires gamma_critical>=0.30 AND the zero-new-critical count). No tuning after results. Success = clean convergence via the two-sided gate on the macrophage module within the round budget, with the post-run HIL materiality review confirming no genuine critical was silenced. Failure modes to report honestly: (a) does not converge -> assume MECHANICAL (dedup/routing/wiring/location-key on a new symbol set), diagnose under cy, do NOT demote gamma; (b) converges but HIL finds a silenced genuine critical -> verifier too aggressive OR A4 mapping wrong. This is the first test of whether the location-keyed two-sided gate is a GENERAL convergence instrument or was specific to composer.py.
_plan_ref: Exp 43, macrophage admissibility (Exp 40-54 matrix). Generalisation test of the Exp 42 convergence redesign + landmark (location-keyed two-sided gate). Runner: reference_runner_v3.py (v2 active for Exp 40-54).
_locationkey_note: 2026-06-10 Exp 43 generalisation test. location_keyed_convergence=true keys the per-round NEW-critical count by which macrophage_cell.py function each critical names (AST-extracted from the 15 target symbols), not by the model-chosen finding-id. This is the same fix proven live on Exp 42 (composer.py converged at round 6). gamma_critical (on the location-keyed critical series) is the ACTIVE first side of the two-sided gate. If macrophage_cell.py converges cleanly too, that is strong evidence the fix is a general convergence instrument.
